categories.main_business_segments: Qunabox Group Limited operates primarily in three business segments: marketing services, merchandise sales, and other related services. Marketing services include standard marketing and value-added AI interactive marketing and data strategy services. Merchandise sales focus on fast-moving consumer goods through experiential vending machines. Other services mainly comprise IT system and software development supporting the core marketing business.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages AI, big data, and Internet of Things (IoT) technologies to power its interactive marketing terminals. Key technological innovations include AI large language models for digital human shopping guides, AI tactile interaction, AI emotion recognition, and multi-sensory interaction capabilities such as scent emitting, movement recognition, and voice interaction. The terminals are strategically placed offline and integrated with an online platform comprising a mobile app and WeChat mini programs to provide seamless consumer engagement.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Qunabox serves brand owners primarily in the consumer goods industry, including food and beverage, new energy vehicles, and household appliances sectors. The company targets key account (KA) customers and a broad base of brand customers, with 294 brand customers and 50 KA customers reported in 2024. The marketing services cater to brand owners seeking innovative AI-powered marketing solutions to engage consumers effectively.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates mainly in Mainland China, with its AI interactive terminal network spread across tier one and new tier one cities. It has also established an overseas business department to explore markets in the Middle East and Singapore. The company’s subsidiaries and principal places of business are located in Shanghai, Zhejiang, Hainan, Hong Kong, Singapore, and the United Arab Emirates.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qunabox operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, providing AI interactive marketing services and merchandise sales to end consumers. It acts as a marketing service provider and distributor of consumer goods through its AI interactive terminals, facilitating consumer engagement and product trial experiences.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on AI interaction innovation, expanding AI hardware and software capabilities, and enriching AI interactive marketing product lines. It invests heavily in R&D to develop multi-sensory AI interaction technologies, including digital human shopping guides, tactile interaction, and emotion recognition. The Group also pursues internationalization, diversification, and strategic mergers and acquisitions to build a comprehensive brand service ecosystem.
categories.revenue_model: Qunabox generates revenue mainly from marketing services (standard and value-added), merchandise sales, and other IT-related services. Marketing services revenue is recognized over time based on labor hours, merchandise sales revenue is recognized at the point of sale via vending machines, and other services revenue is recognized upon completion of customized software development. The company also benefits from government grants, interest income, and exchange gains.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Qunabox positions itself as the largest interactive machine-based marketing service provider in China, focusing on AI-powered marketing solutions for consumer goods. While specific competitors are not named, the company emphasizes its technological leadership, extensive AI terminal network, and integrated online-offline marketing system as key competitive advantages in the marketing services industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The Group has demonstrated rapid growth with revenue increasing from RMB502.4 million in 2021 to RMB1,339.5 million in 2024, representing a compound annual growth rate of 38.7%. Gross profit grew to RMB749.8 million in 2024 with a gross margin of 56.0%. Adjusted EBITDA reached RMB339.7 million in 2024, up 21.2% year-on-year. The company maintains a strong financial position with cash and cash equivalents of RMB892.0 million and a significantly reduced gearing ratio of 25.7% as of 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qunabox offers a unique value proposition by combining AI, big data, and IoT technologies to deliver interactive, multi-sensory marketing experiences through its AI interactive terminals. Its integrated offline and online platform provides brand owners with efficient, accurate, and innovative marketing solutions that enhance consumer engagement and feedback collection. The company’s technological innovations, such as AI large language model-based digital human guides and emotion recognition, differentiate its services by providing personalized and immersive consumer experiences.
